en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

New-product research and communication planning: Supported ZUS Coffee research using audience preferences, social feedback and competitor content to identify product messages and communication themes.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through topic planning, shooting, editing, English copywriting, hashtags and asset organization.

Channel communication and review: Supported online launches and FamilyMart promotion with materials, store information and publishing schedules. Tracked performance weekly and completed 15+ content reviews to improve subsequent content; contributed to account follower growth of 11k+.

University campaign execution: Coordinated university demonstrations and trials, arranged event flow and prepared demos, FAQs, teaching cases and course materials with product and business teams. Organized on-site trials and Q&A, then consolidated feedback into 10 improvement suggestions for product updates and future university pilots.

Market research and user insights: Researched teaching, lesson preparation and self-study needs among university users in mainland China and overseas. Managed communities and classified 100+ feedback items to inform campaign content and improvements.

Content planning: Built the product WeChat content program from scratch and delivered 30+ guides, FAQs, tutorials and use cases. Distilled product messages into reusable content assets; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Channel partnerships: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and project handoff.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

User insights and campaign planning: Collected feedback and conducted pricing surveys to identify product messages and communication priorities. Planned touchpoints by user stage, independently designed selected acquisition campaigns and supported promotion and on-site execution at technology events.
Marketing performance review: Used AI to help build a lightweight operations dashboard, track key metrics and identify drop-off points in the user journey.

Content and creator collaboration: Delivered 100+ WeChat, Xiaohongshu and community posts covering product introductions, use cases and FAQs. Screened creators by audience profile, content relevance and engagement, supported promotional assets and launch tracking, and checked copy and visuals for consistent brand expression.

Channel promotion and conversion optimization: Promoted through Xiaohongshu, WeChat, technology events and communities, tested titles, covers and content, and optimized channel budgets. Campaign registrations rose 50% versus the previous week; first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively.

skills: 2027 Master of Marketing candidate with working English and experience in user insights, brand content, channel promotion and campaign execution.
Marketing: user research, product messaging, content planning, promotional materials, campus events and creator collaboration.
AI: assisted dashboard creation, copy and content ideation, data analysis and reusable SOPs, checklists and templates.
Data: Excel, SPSS and basic SQL; channel testing, communication tracking and campaign reviews.
Content: Xiaohongshu, Instagram and WeChat; Canva, CapCut and basic Figma.
Execution: cross-team coordination, event flow, on-site organization and Q&A; Feishu, DingTalk and Linear.
